sar.narrative: Customer C11923 reported that a $131.30 online transaction (transaction ID 3583368) made on December 29, 2016 at 03:27:44 was unauthorized. The transaction was processed on card C11923-K2 using a device profile (SM-G610F Build/NRD90M, Chrome 66.0 for Android) that the bank's identity records mark as new to this account. The disputed charge is part of a larger suspicious episode containing 84 transactions initiated between December 27 and December 29, 2016, occurring during early morning hours (03:27 to 06:10 and scattered throughout the day). All transactions in the episode were online card-not-present purchases across product codes and billing regions. The $131.30 transaction is notable because it exceeds four times the cardholder's median transaction amount of $28.55, calculated across 10,361 legitimate transactions spanning five months. The device used for this transaction is also connected to account C08962 and matches a pattern (card_not_present_new_device) seen in six prior confirmed fraud cases involving this account. The bank's internal fraud assessment assigned this case a fraud probability of 0.77 based on the pattern match and account history. Account C11923 has experienced ten prior confirmed fraud cases, including four involving card-not-present fraud from new devices or card-testing schemes. The total exposure from the suspicious episode is $3,984.80. The bank created an internal case, applied elevated monitoring to connected cards, and filed a report recommending review for potential card block pending customer verification.
